bibl.title: The God Kothos.
bibl.seg: Robert K. Ritner, The God Kothos.
bibl.note: Complément à: Lincoln H. Blumell & Korshi Dosoo, Horus, Isis, and the Dark-Eyed Beauty. A Series of Magical Ostraca in the Brigham Young University Collection, ArchPF 64 (2018) pp. 247-249. - The spelling ⲕⲟⲑⲟⲥ / ⲅⲟⲑⲟⲥ for ⲁⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ is not an erroneous "corruption" of the Greek term, but a conscious "deformation" for magico-religious reasons.
